summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing it consummated the sale of its 50% stake in Ellomay Luzon Energy Infrastructures Ltd., which indirectly held 33.75% of Dorad Energy Ltd. The final purchase price was NIS 559.8 million, based on a Dorad valuation of NIS 4.4 billion, net of NIS 182.7 million in net debt. Proceeds were partially used for early repayment of Series E Secured Debentures. Board recommended the transaction; no advisors named. The sale sharpens focus on core renewable energy. Risk-arb: deal closed; watch use of proceeds and debenture repayment.
